title: Specified Frobenius comparisons on actual coefficient stages
statement: Fix the purity setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions] and the scheme and geometric Frobenius maps of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. For a $k_0$-scheme $T_0$, put $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$. The ordinary finite comparison is the same relative-Frobenius adjunction mate of [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback], composed with the specified factorization compositor; its derived image is the recorded finite comparison. For each finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, define the whole strict-tower comparison by its maps at every positive quotient: conjugate the ordinary comparison by the recorded finite-pullback presentation maps, apply it degreewise, and restrict scalars back to integral coefficients. These maps and their inverses retain all quotient transitions. Define the integral comparison as the unique natural isomorphism on the actual derived-complete category whose good-complex representative is the Roos image of this whole strict map, conjugated by the recorded representative comparisons of [lem-fix-operation-reduction]. On separated finite-type $T_0$, restrict to the constructible category. Define the rational comparison by scalar-localizing its integral components, and the algebraically closed comparison on every common-field representative by the corresponding rational comparison conjugated by the recorded pullback models of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. These are the specified transports required by [def-pur-tate-datum], with no free comparison data. At each stage the equivariant precomposition equivalence is Mathlib's endofunctor-algebra equivalence associated to this specified isomorphism. The underlying integral, rational and common-stage derived pullback functors and their prescribed object presentations are those of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].
